title: Trace Your Roots
description:
Trace Your Roots

Prompt 1 - I want to build my full family tree. Interview me one section at a time. Ask me everything you need to know: my full name, where my family is from, and every relative I can remember on both sides. Ask for names, approximate birth years, birth places, and how each person is related

Prompt 2 - Based on my last name and where my family came from, tell me the origins of my family line. 

Prompt 3 - Using everything I have told you, search the open web and free public records to find people, documents, and family connections I do not already have. Search these kinds of sources.

Prompt 4 - Build me the full visual family tree using everyone we have confirmed. Lay it out clearly by generation, showing how each person connects. Use my parents and grandparents as anchor points.
